provenance.sourceName: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01
provenance.geographicScope: District 1001 Phra Nakhon (เขตพระนคร) — DOPA registration
provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 5.536 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (38,408) ÷ areaKm2 (5.382 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1001 Phra Nakhon (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.599%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1001 Phra Nakhon (สำนักงานเขตพระนคร)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 53,479.08 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 146.52 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 211.90 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 11.15 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (146.52 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (38,408). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (211.90 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (146.52 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (5.382 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (211.90 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Phra Nakhon (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Phra Nakhon (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.446, W = 0.527, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 3 points ÷ 5.382 km² = 0.557 /km²; waterway share 92.5% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 27.224 t/day/km²; 11.321 km of mapped waterway lines = 2.104 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.446, W = 0.527, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1001 Phra Nakhon
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

BMA does not publish composition by district or by district group (กลุ่มเขต). It publishes composition by disposal centre (On Nut / Nong Khaem / Sai Mai) for FY2563 and FY2564 only; no official district → disposal-centre assignment was found (and assignments change, e.g. temporary diversions to On Nut), so per-centre values are NOT applied to districts.
Hazardous 0.0 = no hazardous category in the BMA table (household hazardous waste is reported separately); not a measured zero.
Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

notesTh: ขยะที่จัดเก็บได้ ปีงบประมาณ 2569 (1 ต.ค. 2568 – 30 ก.ย. 2569); ประชากรตามทะเบียนราษฎร ณ 31 ธ.ค. 2568
ขยะที่เกิดขึ้น = ยอดรวมกรุงเทพฯ ของกรมควบคุมมลพิษ ปี 2568 ปันส่วนตามสัดส่วนขยะที่จัดเก็บได้ของเขตนี้ (ข้อมูลประมาณการ)
องค์ประกอบขยะ = สัดส่วนระดับเมือง ปีงบประมาณ 2565 ที่นำมาใช้กับเขตนี้ (ข้อมูลประมาณการ ไม่มีการสำรวจรายเขต)
จุดเสี่ยงน้ำท่วม สำนักการระบายน้ำ ปี 2568: 3 จุด; ทะเบียนจุดเสี่ยงน้ำท่วม (ทุกสถานะ): 9 จุด
สัดส่วนพื้นที่ในระยะ 300 ม. จากทางน้ำใน OSM: 92.5%; ความยาวทางน้ำที่ทำแผนที่ 11.3 กม.
พื้นที่ตามตาราง กทม.: 5.536 ตร.กม.; พื้นที่จากรูปแปลง: 5.382 ตร.กม.
จุดอ้างอิงจาก data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= จุดกำเนิดหน้าต่างอาคาร 3 มิติ; osm-townhall:way/206391339)
notesEn: Collected waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30); population = DOPA registration at 2025-12-31.
Waste generated = PCD Bangkok total BE 2568 allocated by this district's share of BMA collected tonnage (estimated).
Composition = Bangkok citywide FY BE 2565 shares applied to this district (estimated; no district survey exists).
BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025: 3; DDS flood-risk register (all statuses): 9.
Share within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway: 92.5%; mapped waterway lines 11.3 km.
BMA area table: 5.536 km²; polygon area: 5.382 km².
Anchor from data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= building-window origin; osm-townhall:way/206391339).

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 24.311 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (134,892) ÷ areaKm2 (23.493 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1027 Bueng Kum (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.982%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1027 Bueng Kum (สำนักงานเขตบึงกุ่ม)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 65,210.91 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 178.66 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 262.69 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 13.83 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (178.66 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (134,892). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (262.69 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (178.66 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (23.493 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (262.69 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bueng Kum (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,197.3 mm, 2025 1,317.3 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bueng Kum (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.329, W = 0.277, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0306 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 8 points ÷ 23.493 km² = 0.341 /km²; waterway share 83.3% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 7.605 t/day/km²; 50.985 km of mapped waterway lines = 2.170 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.329, W = 0.277, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0306 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1027 Bueng Kum
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).

provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (116,600) ÷ areaKm2 (12.935 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1029 Bang Sue (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.578%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 209.17 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 11.01 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025

limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (209.17 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bang Sue (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.

See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 10.921 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (74,846) ÷ areaKm2 (8.345 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1031 Bang Kho Laem (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.288%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1031 Bang Kho Laem (สำนักงานเขตบางคอแหลม)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 43,062.71 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 117.98 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 170.70 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 8.98 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (117.98 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (74,846). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (170.70 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (117.98 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (8.345 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (170.70 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bang Kho Laem (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bang Kho Laem (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.308, W = 0.532, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 1 points ÷ 8.345 km² = 0.120 /km²; waterway share 93.4% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 14.138 t/day/km²; 28.243 km of mapped waterway lines = 3.384 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.308, W = 0.532, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1031 Bang Kho Laem
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

องค์ประกอบขยะ = สัดส่วนระดับเมือง ปีงบประมาณ 2565 ที่นำมาใช้กับเขตนี้ (ข้อมูลประมาณการ ไม่มีการสำรวจรายเขต)

พื้นที่ตามตาราง กทม.: 10.921 ตร.กม.; พื้นที่จากรูปแปลง: 8.345 ตร.กม.
จุดอ้างอิงจาก data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= จุดกำเนิดหน้าต่างอาคาร 3 มิติ; osm-townhall:node/374416205)

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 12.994 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (88,304) ÷ areaKm2 (13.291 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1033 Khlong Toei (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 3.190%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1033 Khlong Toei (สำนักงานเขตคลองเตย)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 105,417.97 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 288.82 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 422.86 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 22.26 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (288.82 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (88,304). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (422.86 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (288.82 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (13.291 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (422.86 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Khlong Toei (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,140.5 mm, 2025 1,276.8 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Khlong Toei (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.331, W = 0.315, rainSpatialFactor = 0.9907 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 9 points ÷ 13.291 km² = 0.677 /km²; waterway share 62.1% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 21.730 t/day/km²; 14.609 km of mapped waterway lines = 1.099 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.331, W = 0.315, rainSpatialFactor = 0.9907 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 26.265 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (137,869) ÷ areaKm2 (23.258 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1035 Chom Thong (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.807%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1035 Chom Thong (สำนักงานเขตจอมทอง)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 60,302.83 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 165.21 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 239.46 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 12.60 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (165.21 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (137,869). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (239.46 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (165.21 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (23.258 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (239.46 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Chom Thong (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Chom Thong (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.29, W = 0.367, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 1 points ÷ 23.258 km² = 0.043 /km²; waterway share 94.9% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 7.103 t/day/km²; 66.707 km of mapped waterway lines = 2.868 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.29, W = 0.367, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 7.126 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (61,377) ÷ areaKm2 (7.196 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1037 Ratchathewi (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 2.089%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1037 Ratchathewi (สำนักงานเขตราชเทวี)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 75,959.46 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 208.11 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 276.91 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 14.57 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (208.11 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (61,377). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (276.91 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (208.11 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (7.196 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (276.91 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Ratchathewi (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Ratchathewi (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.499, W = 0.402, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 9 points ÷ 7.196 km² = 1.251 /km²; waterway share 58.2% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 28.920 t/day/km²; 7.482 km of mapped waterway lines = 1.040 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.499, W = 0.402, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 12.565 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (79,736) ÷ areaKm2 (13.046 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1039 Watthana (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 3.201%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1039 Watthana (สำนักงานเขตวัฒนา)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 108,972.23 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 298.55 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 424.32 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 22.33 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (298.55 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (79,736). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).

District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (424.32 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (298.55 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (13.046 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (424.32 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Watthana (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,135.2 mm, 2025 1,274.6 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Watthana (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.282, W = 0.399, rainSpatialFactor = 0.9876 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 8 points ÷ 13.046 km² = 0.613 /km²; waterway share 56.5% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 22.884 t/day/km²; 20.746 km of mapped waterway lines = 1.590 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.282, W = 0.399, rainSpatialFactor = 0.9876 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. จุดอ้างอิงจาก data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= จุดกำเนิดหน้าต่างอาคาร 3 มิติ; osm-townhall:way/176298740)
