provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 22.841 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (97,352) ÷ areaKm2 (22.756 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1041 Lak Si (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.651%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1041 Lak Si (สำนักงานเขตหลักสี่)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 55,942.53 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 153.27 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 218.77 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 11.51 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (153.27 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (97,352). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (218.77 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (153.27 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (22.756 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (218.77 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Lak Si (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,158.1 mm, 2025 1,353.0 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Lak Si (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.304, W = 0.166, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0292 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 11 points ÷ 22.756 km² = 0.483 /km²; waterway share 69.1% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 6.735 t/day/km²; 33.029 km of mapped waterway lines = 1.451 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.304, W = 0.166, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0292 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1041 Lak Si
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

จุดอ้างอิงจาก data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= จุดกำเนิดหน้าต่างอาคาร 3 มิติ; osm-townhall:way/1464539842)

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 25.980 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (93,302) ÷ areaKm2 (25.473 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1043 Khan Na Yao (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.457%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1043 Khan Na Yao (สำนักงานเขตคันนายาว)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 49,975.83 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 136.92 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 193.07 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 10.16 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (136.92 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (93,302). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (193.07 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (136.92 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (25.473 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (193.07 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Khan Na Yao (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,197.3 mm, 2025 1,317.3 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Khan Na Yao (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.243, W = 0.239, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0306 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 1 points ÷ 25.473 km² = 0.039 /km²; waterway share 85.7% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 5.375 t/day/km²; 53.691 km of mapped waterway lines = 2.108 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.243, W = 0.239, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0306 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.geographicScope: District 1045 Wang Thonglang (เขตวังทองหลาง) — DOPA registration
provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 19.265 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (102,281) ÷ areaKm2 (17.140 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1045 Wang Thonglang (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 2.406%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1045 Wang Thonglang (สำนักงานเขตวังทองหลาง)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 80,004.66 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 219.19 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 318.92 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 16.79 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (219.19 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (102,281). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (318.92 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (219.19 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (17.140 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (318.92 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Wang Thonglang (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,164.9 mm, 2025 1,294.0 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Wang Thonglang (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.282, W = 0.235, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0078 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 8 points ÷ 17.140 km² = 0.467 /km²; waterway share 65.9% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 12.788 t/day/km²; 23.537 km of mapped waterway lines = 1.373 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.282, W = 0.235, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0078 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1045 Wang Thonglang
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

BMA does not publish composition by district or by district group (กลุ่มเขต). It publishes composition by disposal centre (On Nut / Nong Khaem / Sai Mai) for FY2563 and FY2564 only; no official district → disposal-centre assignment was found (and assignments change, e.g. temporary diversions to On Nut), so per-centre values are NOT applied to districts.
Hazardous 0.0 = no hazardous category in the BMA table (household hazardous waste is reported separately); not a measured zero.
Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

notesTh: ขยะที่จัดเก็บได้ ปีงบประมาณ 2569 (1 ต.ค. 2568 – 30 ก.ย. 2569); ประชากรตามทะเบียนราษฎร ณ 31 ธ.ค. 2568
ขยะที่เกิดขึ้น = ยอดรวมกรุงเทพฯ ของกรมควบคุมมลพิษ ปี 2568 ปันส่วนตามสัดส่วนขยะที่จัดเก็บได้ของเขตนี้ (ข้อมูลประมาณการ)
องค์ประกอบขยะ = สัดส่วนระดับเมือง ปีงบประมาณ 2565 ที่นำมาใช้กับเขตนี้ (ข้อมูลประมาณการ ไม่มีการสำรวจรายเขต)
จุดเสี่ยงน้ำท่วม สำนักการระบายน้ำ ปี 2568: 8 จุด; ทะเบียนจุดเสี่ยงน้ำท่วม (ทุกสถานะ): 14 จุด
สัดส่วนพื้นที่ในระยะ 300 ม. จากทางน้ำใน OSM: 65.9%; ความยาวทางน้ำที่ทำแผนที่ 23.5 กม.
พื้นที่ตามตาราง กทม.: 19.265 ตร.กม.; พื้นที่จากรูปแปลง: 17.140 ตร.กม.
จุดอ้างอิงจาก data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= จุดกำเนิดหน้าต่างอาคาร 3 มิติ; point-on-surface)
notesEn: Collected waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30); population = DOPA registration at 2025-12-31.
Waste generated = PCD Bangkok total BE 2568 allocated by this district's share of BMA collected tonnage (estimated).
Composition = Bangkok citywide FY BE 2565 shares applied to this district (estimated; no district survey exists).
BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025: 8; DDS flood-risk register (all statuses): 14.
Share within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway: 65.9%; mapped waterway lines 23.5 km.
BMA area table: 19.265 km²; polygon area: 17.140 km².
Anchor from data/staged/bangkok-anchors.json (= building-window origin; point-on-surface).

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: Bangkok 50 district administrative boundaries (BMA GIS, shapefile EPSG:32647)
provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².
limitations: BMA's published area table gives 18.789 km² for this district; the polygon area is used here so that densities match the mapped geometry.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (84,574) ÷ areaKm2 (19.019 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1047 Bang Na (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 2.022%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

provenance.sourceName: BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office
provenance.geographicScope: District office 1047 Bang Na (สำนักงานเขตบางนา)
provenance.methodology: Collected municipal solid waste (มูลฝอยที่จัดเก็บได้) delivered by the district office in FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30): 66,986.20 t ÷ 365 days (as stated in the BMA table header) = 183.52 t/day; reproduces the publisher's own daily-average column. Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: simulateAccumulation(inflow = wasteGenerated 268.00 t/day, η = 0.95 (baseline scenario), 30 daily steps, A₀ = 0) — final stock; steady state G·(1−η)/η = 14.11 t. Model v1.0.0; see docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md §13.
limitations: Illustrative stock model, not a measured quantity of uncollected waste.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (183.52 t/day) × 1000 ÷ population (84,574). Waste FY BE 2569; population at 2025-12-31.
limitations: Cross-period: waste FY BE 2569 (2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30) ÷ registered population at 2025-12-31 (inside the fiscal year).
Registered population understates the people actually served (commuters, unregistered residents), which inflates per-capita values, especially in central districts.
District values exclude the unallocated 'Others' row.
Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (268.00 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: collected waste (BMA collected solid waste statistics, fiscal year 2026 (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), by district office) ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (183.52 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (19.019 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (268.00 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bang Na (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,194.3 mm, 2025 1,315.1 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Bang Na (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.187, W = 0.141, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0285 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 7 points ÷ 19.019 km² = 0.368 /km²; waterway share 53.6% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).
limitations: Proxy index of relative exposure within Bangkok (0 = lowest district, 1 = highest); not a hydraulic flood hazard map and not comparable with Hat Yai.

Flood-risk points are the DDS designated list for the season (counted by the district stated by the agency; 20 of 216 points plot in a neighbouring district). Point counts reflect administrative designation, not flood depth or frequency.
OSM waterway mapping completeness varies; weights 0.7/0.3 are demonstration assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 9.649 t/day/km²; 18.865 km of mapped waterway lines = 0.992 km/km² (lines split into ≤20 m pieces assigned by midpoint).
limitations: Proxy for how much waste pressure coincides with open drainage channels; it does not measure actual blockage. Waste is a possible contributing factor, not a proven cause of flooding.
Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Urban Intelligence illustrative flood-risk / accumulation model v1.0.0
provenance.methodology: Modelled flood-risk score (class low, completeness 1) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.187, W = 0.141, rainSpatialFactor = 1.0285 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1047 Bang Na
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

provenance.methodology: DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (BE 2568), as tabulated by NSO (table OS_0405_01_0005_01) and cross-checked against the DOPA stat_a files (all 50 districts equal).

provenance.methodology: Geodesic area of the published polygon (turf.area, WGS84), rounded to 0.001 km².

provenance.sourceName: Derived: Registered population by district (DOPA civil registration), NSO official statistics table OS_0405_01_0005_01 ÷ polygon area
provenance.methodology: population (123,887) ÷ areaKm2 (33.080 km²), rounded to 0.1 persons/km².
limitations: Registered (de jure) population; excludes unregistered residents, migrant workers, students and daytime commuters.

provenance.sourceName: PCD สถานการณ์ขยะมูลฝอยของประเทศ (city total) × BMA Environment Department collected-by-district share
provenance.geographicScope: District 1049 Thung Khru (allocated from the Bangkok-wide PCD total)
provenance.methodology: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
limitations: Allocation assumes each district's share of generation equals its share of BMA-collected tonnage. Districts with more recycling/sale at source or less collection coverage are under-estimated, and vice versa. No district generation survey exists.
PCD's Bangkok 'generated' equals utilised + correctly disposed (an accounting identity in PCD's table), not an independent measurement at source.
PCD reporting-year basis (calendar vs fiscal) is not stated; matched to the BMA fiscal year with the same BE number.
The BMA 'Others' row (Environment Department's own collection) cannot be located in a district; it is spread pro rata.
Different year from the collected figure: generated = PCD BE 2568 allocated with BMA FY BE 2568 shares (district share 1.483%); collected = BMA FY BE 2569. Do not subtract one from the other.

Year label = Gregorian year in which the fiscal year ends.
limitations: Collected tonnage, not generation: excludes uncollected, informally recycled and self-disposed waste.
Waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices ('Others', 215.09 t/day in FY BE 2569) is not allocated to any district.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2026 ÷ DOPA registered population 2025

provenance.methodology: Measure: COLLECTED waste (not generated). wasteCollected (139.01 t/day) ÷ areaKm2 (33.080 km²).
limitations: Uses collected waste only. A separate generated-waste figure (196.57 t/day (2025), status estimated) exists but is a different measure and is not mixed in.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Area anchor of Thung Khru (IDW of 4 nearest ERA5 lattice points)
provenance.methodology: Mean of the annual totals of the area's IDW daily series (rain-areas.json) over complete calendar years: 2024 1,111.5 mm, 2025 1,257.7 mm.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Modelled reanalysis, not rain-gauge observations; ERA5 smooths convective storms.
For scale: the TMD 1991-2020 climatological normal at station 48455 (BANGKOK METROPOLIS) is 1,702.2 mm/year (gauge statistic, different period and method).

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation

provenance.methodology: Daily reanalysis total for the latest date in the series (2026-10-28, local day ≈ 23:00–23:00), from rain-areas.json (IDW of the ERA5 lattice).
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.
Latest COMPLETE ERA5 day at retrieval (≈5-day latency) — not a real-time reading; preliminary ERA5T data may be revised. Real-time gauge snapshots are in stations.json.

provenance.methodology: Modelled drainage stress (D × 100) from computeAreaRisk(model v1.0.0) with the BASELINE scenario (10 mm/h × 2 h, capacity reduction 0, obstruction 0.3, upstream 0.2, η 0.95), design intensity 60 mm/h, inputs E = 0.234, W = 0.238, rainSpatialFactor = 0.971 (area annual rainfall ÷ mean over the city's areas). See docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md.
limitations: Illustrative scenario output — not an official flood forecast; weights and capacity are demo assumptions.

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA DDS flood-risk points 2025 (bma-dds-flood-risk-2568) + OpenStreetMap waterways (osm-bkk-waterways)
provenance.methodology: E = 0.7 × minmax(flood-risk points per km²) + 0.3 × minmax(share of district area within 300 m of a mapped OSM waterway), min–max over the 50 districts. This district: 0 points ÷ 33.080 km² = 0.000 /km²; waterway share 86.5% (100 m sample lattice; river, canal, stream, drain lines and water-area polygons).

provenance.sourceName: Derived: BMA collected waste FY2569 by district + OpenStreetMap waterway length
provenance.methodology: W = 0.5 × minmax(collected waste density, t/day/km²) + 0.5 × minmax(OSM waterway line length density, km/km²), min–max over the 50 districts. Relative index within Bangkok; OSM waterway completeness varies; equal weights are a demonstration assumption.

provenance.sourceName: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis (models=era5), daily and hourly precipitation
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok — area-weighted mean of the 50 areas
provenance.methodology: Area-weighted mean (weights = areaKm2) of the areas' ERA5 mean annual totals over complete calendar years.
limitations: ERA5 reanalysis cells are 0.25° (≈27–28 km): neighbouring areas mostly share the same cell(s), so rainfall differences between neighbouring areas are mostly NOT resolved — the IDW only smooths between cell values and adds no local detail.

ERA5 area-weighted mean (1,243.0 mm/year) is 73% of the TMD 1991-2020 normal at station 48455 BANGKOK METROPOLIS (1,702.2 mm/year); use reanalysis values for relative comparison and timing, not as absolute local depths.

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok (BMA) municipal solid waste — city level, not national
provenance.methodology: Published physical composition (% by weight, 14 categories) aggregated into 6 app categories (mapping below) and rounded to 0.1 with the largest-remainder method so shares sum to exactly 100.0. Mapping: organic = food waste + wood/branches/leaves (biodegradable organics). plastic = recyclable + non-recyclable plastic + foam (expanded polystyrene is a plastic). paper = recyclable + non-recyclable paper. glassMetal = glass + metal. hazardous = 0.0: the BMA physical-composition table has NO hazardous category (household hazardous waste is collected and reported separately). 0.0 means 'not reported as a separate category', not a measured zero. other = leather & rubber + textiles + stone & ceramics + bones & shells + disposable diapers (bones/shells treated as inert, not readily biodegradable).
limitations: Composition of collected waste arriving at BMA disposal facilities; not district-specific.
Hazardous waste is not a category in the source table; hazardous share shown as 0.0 = not reported.
The BMA open-data CSV labelled 2565 (garbage_element.csv) has different values from the FY2565 PDF; the PDF was preferred (explicit fiscal-year title and author unit). Both are recorded.

Sample scope: Bangkok municipal solid waste (city level; not national). Sampling locations/number of samples not stated on the FY2565 table; previous years' tables report sampling at BMA's three disposal centres (On Nut, Nong Khaem, Sai Mai).
City-level shares; BMA publishes no district-level (or district-group) composition. Each district carries these shares as an ESTIMATE.

Waste figures are COLLECTED tonnage by district office (BMA Environment Department, FY BE 2569 = 2025-10-01 – 2026-09-30), not generation. The city total (9,491.78 t/day) includes an unallocated 'Others' row (215.09 t/day), so the 50 districts sum to less (9,276.68 t/day).
Population is DOPA registered population at 2025-12-31 (de jure), not resident or daytime population.

Waste GENERATED is a separate measure: Pollution Control Department Bangkok total 13,254 t/day for BE 2568 (observed; PCD does not state calendar vs fiscal year). District generated values are ESTIMATES that allocate this total by each district's share of BMA collected tonnage (FY BE 2568); the BMA 'Others' row (3.92% of collected tonnage) is spread pro rata. Generated and collected values are never mixed: per-capita, density, the obstruction index W and rankings use collected waste; the modelled accumulation stock uses generated waste as inflow.

Composition is citywide (BMA FY BE 2565); the source table has no hazardous-waste category, so hazardous = 0.0 means "not reported", not a measured zero. BMA publishes no district or district-group composition, so every district shows the citywide shares as an estimate.

Rainfall is ERA5 reanalysis (0.25° cells; 11 distinct cells over the 42-point lattice): differences between neighbouring districts are mostly not resolved, and ERA5 annual totals run below the TMD station normal (1,702.2 mm/year at 48455, 1991-2020). Real-time gauge readings are snapshots (stations.json).
Flood exposure (E) and obstruction susceptibility (W) are relative proxy indices built from BMA flood-risk point counts, waste density and OSM waterways; OSM drainage mapping is incomplete.
Drainage stress and modelled flood risk are illustrative outputs of the demo model (baseline scenario; assumed design intensity 60 mm/h, cf. the BMA statement of 60 mm/h) — not an official forecast.

Flood events (3) are documented historical events with cited sources (HII, World Bank, ThaiWater, BMA via Thai PBS); peak rainfall values are single-gauge maxima, not areal averages, and no flood-extent polygons are included.
District polygons: BMA GIS (official, exported 2020); polygon areas differ from BMA's published area table for some districts.
